source_snapshot.criteria: The system powers on normally and the memory information is correct in each slot.

old_problem: The active review left the case pending because 'partial memory (2DPC)' does not itself name installed slots or expected capacity. Those values must come from the platform population recipe, but the purpose, physical method, SMBIOS readback and safety boundary are already clear. The approved parameterization rule permits the exact population and boot oracle to remain mandatory project configuration.
disposition_reason: DMTF SMBIOS defines Physical Memory Array, Memory Device and mapped-address structures suitable for topology reconciliation, while the platform recipe must authoritatively bind the supported socket/channel/slot matrix. ED-03 permits those project identities, ED-09 assigns DIMM handling to a qualified human, ED-15 forbids PASS without the approved population/capacity/error oracle, and ED-18 preserves the complete power-off-to-OS-ready transition. No population is guessed.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row428 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history3019 and adjacent row427 Topodiff plus row429 Intel SSMD cases.
Applied DMTF SMBIOS Types 16/17/19/20 to distinguish physical arrays, individual memory devices and mapped address ranges; a total-memory value alone cannot prove slot correctness.
Preserved the real partial-2DPC physical configuration and power-on coverage; corrected DeepSeek's erroneous reference to full memory and rejected SSH-only substitution.
Made the platform-approved installed/empty slot matrix, expected trained/usable capacity and RAS policy mandatory runtime configuration rather than an unresolved review question.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row429 and verified its manifest identity; no DIMM, power or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Approved partial-2DPC cold boot, training and physical-slot inventory reconciliation
test_case.purpose: Verify the platform cold-boots normally with the exact supported partial-2DPC DIMM matrix and that firmware/SMBIOS/OS evidence maps every installed and intentionally empty slot to the approved physical plan without training or RAS errors.
required_package: Platform-authoritative partial-2DPC socket/channel/slot population rule and silk-screen-to-SMBIOS locator map
DIMM serial/part/capacity/rank/speed inventory and approved installed/empty worksheet
Qualified ESD operator, maintenance power window, OOB/console access and reference-population recovery plan
Pinned approved dmidecode package plus OS tools for usable-memory and EDAC/RAS evidence
Project-approved POST/training deadline, expected trained/usable capacity and error policy
test_case.test_command: Record the reference DIMM and health state; shut down, remove power, verify discharge and apply ESD controls. A qualified operator installs the approved partial-2DPC matrix and records real slot/label/serial photos. Perform one cold power-on with console/POST capture. After OS readiness, capture the pinned dmidecode version and complete SMBIOS Types 16, 17, 19 and 20, `free -b`, EDAC/RAS/kernel evidence and SEL without clearing logs. Reconcile every installed and empty physical slot, module identity, trained speed/capacity and OS-usable total to the approved worksheet, then restore the reference population when required and verify post-health.
test_case.expected_result: The system reaches OS Ready within the approved cold-boot/training deadline. Every intended DIMM is present in the correct mapped slot with matching identity/capacity attributes, every intended empty slot remains empty, mapped and usable capacity meet the approved calculation, and no unaccepted POST, training, EDAC, RAS, kernel or SEL error appears.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires an authoritative population worksheet and locator map, real physical evidence, complete OFF-to-OS-ready console timing, all relevant SMBIOS structures, calculated trained/usable capacity and clean approved error evidence. Without the platform recipe, exact slot map or expected-capacity/error oracle the execution result is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS. A plausible total or `dmidecode -t memory` alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Full shutdown, external power removal, discharge verification and ESD handling before any DIMM movement
Qualified operator only; preserve each removed module by labeled original position and never service memory live
Maintain OOB/console access and abort on seating concern, smoke, repeated POST loop, training failure or new RAS event
Preserve logs and physical evidence; restore the approved reference matrix once and never auto-retry a failed boot
expected_evidence: Platform population rule, physical-to-SMBIOS locator map and signed installed/empty worksheet
Before/after slot photos with DIMM labels, serials and ESD/power record
Cold-boot console/POST/training timeline through OS Ready
Pinned dmidecode version and complete Types 16/17/19/20 plus `free -b` output
Capacity/slot reconciliation, EDAC/RAS/kernel/SEL delta, restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On failed POST, unexpected population or RAS error, remove power under the same ESD controls, preserve console/log/slot evidence, have the operator reseat only when explicitly directed or restore the labeled reference DIMM matrix, then verify reference boot and health. Do not move DIMMs live or retry power-on automatically.

external_authorities.title: DMTF SMBIOS Reference Specification DSP0134
external_authorities.applied_rule: Defines Physical Memory Array, Memory Device and memory mapped-address structures used for slot and capacity reconciliation.
